blocks.text: Alas Pilipinas' Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara are relegated to the bronze medal match after their 21-23, 18-21 semifinal loss to Thailand's Worapeerachayakorn Kongphopsarutawadee and Taravadee Naraphornrapat in the women's beach volleyball tournament of the 20th Asian Games on Thursday.
